newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA TO SPEND A$100 MLN ON MILLENNIUM.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA TO SPEND A$100 MLN ON MILLENNIUM.

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia said on Wednesday that it would spend more than A$100 million to fix potential problems posed by the Year 2000 Millennium Bug.
Asked how much the big four bank would spend on fixing the problem, CBA managing director David Murray replied; "Over A$100 million."
"We hope to have that complete by the end of next year."

The Reserve Bank recently said it expected Australia's big four banks to spend more than A$350 million on fixing the problems posed by the bug, which corrupts date stamps inside computers and can potentially cause system crashes.
The other big banks are National Australia Bank Ltd, Westpac Banking Corp, and Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd.
